task: Implement ES index deletion phase for stale datasources with STALE→ARCHIVED lifecycle transition, shared-index guard, circuit-breaker cap, reactivation hook in IndexInfo.complete_progress(), two new config flags, Helm values entries, and lock ID collision fix

key_reasoning.reason: StaleDatasourceService (new _delete_stale_indexes method), IndexInfo (complete_progress reactivation hook), AppConfig (two new flags), StaleDatasourceScheduler (stats logging), AgentMonitoringService + MetricName (new deletion metric), ElasticSearchClient (direct index deletion call), deploy-templates/values.yaml (Helm entries), and stale_datasource/config.py (lock ID fix) — six-plus components across Service, DB-Persistence, External, Config/Infrastructure, and Monitoring layers. Red flag applied: IndexInfo.complete_progress() is a core shared model method called by all datasource indexing completion flows throughout the application.

ES index deletion is destructive and not reversible without full reindexing; lock ID collision (987654324 shared with spend-tracking reconciliation scheduler) is a live production bug causing silent nightly failure of one of the two jobs; complete_progress() reactivation hook has a non-trivial implementation risk — _build_progress_update_kwargs does not currently accept lifecycle_state or marked_stale_at, and incorrect write ordering could silently discard the lifecycle reset. Feature flag STALE_DATASOURCE_DELETION_ENABLED defaults to False, partially mitigating deployment risk.

Nine files modified across six directories: src/codemie/configs/config.py, src/codemie/rest_api/models/index.py, src/codemie/service/stale_datasource/stale_datasource_service.py, src/codemie/service/stale_datasource/config.py, src/codemie/service/stale_datasource/scheduler.py, deploy-templates/values.yaml, src/codemie/service/analytics/metric_names.py, tests/codemie/service/stale_datasource/test_stale_datasource_service.py, and tests/codemie/rest_api/models/test_index_info.py. No new files; all are modifications to existing files.

Service (StaleDatasourceService), DB-Persistence (IndexInfo model modification), External (ElasticSearchClient ES index deletion), Config/Infrastructure (AppConfig new config fields and Helm values) — four distinct architectural layers. No API, UI, or workflow layers are touched.

red_flags_applied: Component Scope bumped from L (4) to XL (5): IndexInfo.complete_progress() is a core shared model method invoked by all datasource indexing completions across the application — qualifies as touching a core shared utility
